client_rule: treat as opaque string by default
rationale: server is the current authority on accepted key grammar

client_rule: allow optional hint fields in DTOs but do not trust them as authoritative
rationale: server may ignore or derive kind values

client_rule: preserve client-side placeholders across create flows
rationale: this is needed for provisional object mapping

client_rule: preserve exact server version strings and send them back on optimistic writes
rationale: client should not invent version formats

client_rule: carry mock or auth-related values through the payload without interpreting them deeply
rationale: server controls forcing and validation behavior

client_rule: limit client validation to nullability and obvious request-shape checks
rationale: avoid duplicating parsing logic that may move into another package
